scope: 0.10.1-claudegpt.24: stage 2 slice 5 of the Rust migration. StateStore saves through the PTY host's state=1 service whenever the attached host advertises it (checked per save; a hot-swapped older host without it, e.g. .22, saves synchronously in-process). One write in flight, newer snapshots replace queued ones, conflict re-reads the revision and retries once with the newest snapshot, non-conflict failures fall back to the in-process write with a warning. flush(deadline?) resolves when the newest snapshot (debounced too) is on disk; with a deadline (5 s) an unanswering host is abandoned and the newest snapshot written in-process, later saves too, and a late host answer cannot write an older snapshot. Awaited in shutdown() before sessions end and the host is let go, after the host stops, and at the end of bulk chat batches; flushState() test hook; e2e helpers' state()/byName() are async and flush the running app before reading state.json. No protocol bump, no Rust changes
